about: Every place Thingy appears, what it takes from his home, and what it keeps of its own. tests/contract.test.ts holds the newest model to the stills named here, and tools/persona-rollout.mjs turns this file into the checklist for a persona change.

surfaces.name: Ask Thingy
keeps: AGENTS.md: what each face means here, and which faces a tap may show
web/src/react/components/ThingyFace.tsx: the small drawn screen face, four moods
web/src/react/components/answer-mood.ts: when he has really found something
web/public/img/thingy.png: the illustration, for og:image and the app icons
Copy on the home, About and Connect pages

surfaces.name: Ask Thingy's chat, and his print persona
surfaces.job: Librarian, and host of Supporting Membership in print
keeps: apps/librarian/lambda/prompts/thingy-identity.md: who he is, condensed for every chat turn
apps/librarian/lambda/prompts/words-he-does-not-use.md: the one list his prompts render
apps/librarian/prompts/thingy-persona.md: the print persona that WT Builder vendors

surfaces.name: WT Builder
surfaces.job: Librarian in Echoes, host of Supporting Membership, narrator of the audio edition
keeps: prompts/thingy-persona.md: vendored from librarian-thing with npm run persona:sync, so change librarian-thing first
